segment.source: Renders one tight row of icons with one- or two-word labels and no descriptions at all — the quiet strip that sits directly under a hero and names what the product covers. Use it for: reassurance strips, shipping and returns promises, coverage summaries, certification rows, the compact restatement of a feature grid near the fold. Prefer 'Feature Grid' when each entry needs a sentence, and 'Integration Grid' when the marks are third-party logos rather than icons.
